versions.changelog:
- Initial release providing automated Xiaohongshu keyword search and note detail extraction.
- Enables hot content discovery, competitor analysis, and trend monitoring for business analysis.
- Supports flexible search customization (note type, sorting, output format, quantity).
- Outputs data in JSON or Markdown for direct reporting use.
- Command-line tool, requires Node.js 16.14.0+ and API token configuration.
